summary: Full matrix of Tutup Kasir cash reconciliation backend tests (cases 1-8) + frontend verification of the Kas Keluar petty-method removal and Tutup Kasir sheet. All 9 pytest cases PASSED. Frontend testIDs for close-kas-awal/pemasukan/pengeluaran/kas-sistem/kas-aktual-input/selisih-value/selisih-label/confirm-close-register-button all present; live selisih updates correctly on kas_aktual change. petty-method testID and 'Sumber dana'/'Jenis pengeluaran' labels are absent in /pos Kas Keluar sheet as required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1400 lines; splitting into modules (auth, pos, finance, inventory, payroll) would improve maintainability.

pos_close() reuses pos_summary() result and overrides some ledger-derived fields on the inserted doc; current spread is correct (overrides come last) but is fragile — consider computing the record explicitly instead of relying on spread order.

cash_ledger legacy records: /pos/summary.closings may return old register_closes docs missing kas_awal/kas_aktual/selisih; frontend should defensively default these to 0 (currently handled, verified).
seed_data_creation: Each pytest case opens/closes a fresh register session via /api/register/open & /api/pos/close; creates TEST_ prefixed cash sales (manual items) and expenses. All data is bound to the session and cleaned up on close.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_tutup_kasir.py covers cases 1-8 using the real preview URL. Export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running. Frontend uses testIDs: close-kas-awal, close-pemasukan, close-pengeluaran, close-kas-sistem, close-kas-aktual-input, close-selisih-value, close-selisih-label (both only render AFTER kas_aktual input has a value — conditional render), confirm-close-register-button, pos-petty-button, petty-sheet. The old petty-method testID has been correctly removed.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — no bugs found. Reconciliation math is correct: kas_sistem = opening_cash + sum(finance.income where method=Cash, session_id=current) - sum(finance.expense where method=Cash, session_id=current). Non-cash sales (QRIS/Debit/Transfer) are excluded because add_finance tags income lines with the sale's payment_method so cash_ledger filter {method: 'Cash'} ignores them. selisih = round(kas_aktual - kas_sistem, 2), sign convention: negative=Kurang, positive=Lebih, zero=Seimbang — verified in all three close cases.
